parts.name: Frame
parts.Basic_description: The frame of the clock, made of plastic, forms the outer structure and holds the internal components together.
parts.Functional_description: It provides structural support and houses the clock mechanism and surface.
parts.Movement_description: It is a fixed part and does not move during operation.

parts.name: Hour Hand
parts.Basic_description: The hour hand of the clock, made of aluminum, is a small rotating component attached to the central axis.
parts.Functional_description: It indicates the hour by rotating slowly around the clock face.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around the central axis at a slow, constant rate.

parts.name: Minute Hand
parts.Basic_description: The minute hand of the clock, made of aluminum, is a slender rotating component attached to the central axis.
parts.Functional_description: It indicates the minutes by rotating around the clock face once every hour.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around the central axis at a moderate, continuous rate.

parts.name: Second Hand
parts.Basic_description: The second hand of the clock, made of aluminum, is a thin rotating component attached to the central axis.
parts.Functional_description: It indicates the seconds by rotating around the clock face once every 60 seconds.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around the central axis at a fast, continuous or ticking rate.

parts.name: Surface
parts.Basic_description: The surface of the clock, made of glass, covers and protects the hands and dial.
parts.Functional_description: It provides a transparent protective layer allowing visibility of the clock hands and numbers.
parts.Movement_description: It is a fixed part and does not move during operation.
